data.name: Aborn
data.gender_notes: Aborn is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Latin, 'abor' means 'arise' or 'rise up'. This name has been used in Christian traditions as a symbol of new life, renewal, and resurrection. The name Aborn carries the meaning “Arising, Rising Up” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aborn usually hope their child will grow to embody arising, rising up and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of new life, hope, and resurrection
data.etymology: Aborn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Arising, Rising Up.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aborn total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
